title: euphrasia collina subsp. deflexifolia
intro: Euphrasia collina subsp. deflexifolia, commonly known as a type of gentian, is a plant species within the Gentianaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, particularly in treating respiratory issues and digestive problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include stimulating the immune system, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of Euphrasia collina subsp. deflexifolia include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
